itemsSent.title: European gas surges as U.S. strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island
itemsSent.why: US strikes near Strait of Hormuz sparked acute supply disruption fears, driving European natural gas prices sharply higher.

itemsSent.title: Iran doubles Hormuz blacklist with Sinokor, KOTC fleets targeted
itemsSent.why: Expanding Hormuz blacklists raises geopolitical risk premiums and threatens vital crude transit flows through the Middle East.

itemsSent.title: Crude oil prices fall for second day as market hopes for diplomatic resolution to Iran war
itemsSent.why: Crude fell for a second day as hopes for a diplomatic resolution to the Iran conflict eased supply disruption fears.

itemsSent.title: Dubai Benchmark Slips Into Contango for the First Time Since July
itemsSent.why: Dubai benchmark entering contango signals rising Middle Eastern physical flows exceeding demand, pressuring Brent prices lower near-term.

itemsSent.title: Brent Flash Crashes $6 Before Rebounding Towards $104
itemsSent.why: Geopolitical headlines causing extreme volatility: Brent flash crash on Iran peace rumors, but ongoing Strait of Hormuz risks drive diverging crude and product dynamics.

itemsSent.title: Iran War Triples Logistics Costs for Oil Services Firms
itemsSent.why: Higher logistics, labor, and fuel costs in the Middle East due to the ongoing conflict increase upstream operational expenses, supporting crude prices.

itemsSent.title: ENGINE: East of Suez Bunker Fuel Availability Outlook
itemsSent.why: Tight bunker fuel availability in Singapore supports marine fuels and middle distillates, but has limited immediate impact on headline crude benchmarks.

itemsSent.title: Iran War Doubles Egypt’s LNG Bill as Gas Output Keeps Falling
itemsSent.why: Egypt burning fuel oil instead of gas boosts HO/fuel oil demand while falling local gas output shows broader regional energy stress.

itemsSent.title: Global Diesel Crunch Set to Last Well Into 2027
itemsSent.why: Middle East refining capacity cuts have crashed diesel imports into Asia, creating a prolonged global diesel crunch supporting prices.
